name: Zendesk
description: Zendesk is an AI-first customer service platform combining self-learning AI agents with unified ticketing and omnichannel workflow tools, serving both customer service and internal employee service use cases.
best_for: Positioned for customer service teams, employee/IT/HR service departments, and contact centers spanning startups to large enterprises across industries like retail, financial services, healthcare, and government.
features: AI agents that autonomously resolve tickets end-to-end
Unified omnichannel inbox (email, chat, phone, social, messaging)
Knowledge base / help center for self-service
AI-driven quality assurance and analytics dashboards

alternatives.name: Intercom
alternatives.description: A customer service platform pairing a full helpdesk with Fin, a natively integrated AI agent.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses wanting AI-agent-led resolution alongside human conversations.

alternatives.name: Freshdesk
alternatives.description: An AI-powered customer service solution designed to be easy to set up and boost agent productivity.
alternatives.best_for: Mid-market to enterprise support teams wanting quick setup and AI ticket resolution.

alternatives.name: Zoho Desk
alternatives.description: An AI-powered customer service platform that unifies support conversations across channels into one inbox, with a Zia AI assistant that handles routine tickets autonomously.
alternatives.best_for: Customer-first businesses wanting unified multichannel ticketing with AI automation
